scripts.build:libs: npm -w hls run build && npm -w encode-config run build && npm -w segment-editor run build && npm -w player-core run build && npm -w player-web run build && npm -w player-web-legacy run build
scripts.build:bundled: npm run build:libs && npm -w api run build && npm -w app run build
scripts.dev: npm run predev && concurrently -k -n ecfg,segd,hls,pcor,plyw,plyl,api,app -c green,gray,white,cyan,red,yellow,blue,magenta "npm -w encode-config run dev" "npm -w segment-editor run dev" "npm -w hls run dev" "npm -w player-core run dev" "npm -w player-web run dev" "npm -w player-web-legacy run dev" "npm -w api run dev" "npm -w app run dev"
scripts.predev:electron: npm run build:libs && npm -w api run build
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n ecfg,segd,hls,pcor,plyw,plyl,app,elec -c green,gray,white,cyan,red,blue,magenta,yellow "npm -w encode-config run dev" "npm -w segment-editor run dev" "npm -w hls run dev" "npm -w player-core run dev" "npm -w player-web run dev" "npm -w player-web-legacy run dev" "npm -w app run dev" "npm -w electron run dev"
